story.fullStory:
Abba's "Dancing Queen" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Dancing Queen" is a song by Swedish pop group ABBA, released as the lead single from their fourth studio album, Arrival (1976).

It was written by Benny Andersson, Björn Ulvaeus and Stig Anderson.

Andersson and Ulvaeus also produced the song.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

facts.text: "Dancing Queen" is a song by Swedish pop group ABBA, released as the lead single from their fourth studio album, Arrival (1976).
It was written by Benny Andersson, Björn Ulvaeus and Stig Anderson.
Andersson and Ulvaeus also produced the song.
The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.
ABBA: The Album (also known as simply The Album) is the fifth studio album by the Swedish pop group ABBA.

It was released in Scandinavia on 12 December 1977 through Polar Music, but due to the massive amount of pre-orders, the UK pressing plants were not able to press sufficient copies before Christmas 1977 and so it was not released in the UK until January 1978.
The album was released in conjunction with ABBA: The Movie, with the same cover, technically functioning as the soundtrack, with several of the songs featured in the film.

ABBA Voyage is a virtual concert residency by the Swedish pop group ABBA.
